issues: Header action row is clipped/overflows vertically: copy-link-btn and download-report-btn have bounding y=-4 (partly above the header) and report-new-experiment wraps to a second row that sits outside the header's background band, overlapping page content. All three remain clickable, so it is cosmetic only. Suggest allowing the header to grow (h-auto + py) or collapsing the actions into an icon-only row at <420px.
Product Name input still uses focus:ring-white/50 while the description textarea uses focus:ring-ring — inconsistent focus ring token (and white ring is barely visible in light theme).
Uses native window.confirm('Delete this audience profile?') instead of the shadcn AlertDialog used elsewhere — inconsistent with the rest of the UI and untestable without dialog handlers.

action_items: COPY/LOGIC (medium): Learning note wording contradicts the metric deltas. On the run I did, impressions were PRED 17,629 vs REAL 1,000 (-94.3%) yet the note read 'This launch OVERPERFORMED — reality beat prediction by 94% on impressions'. The overall badge (OVERPERFORMED +174.1%) came from the other metrics. The generator appears to use abs() of the impressions delta and/or attributes the aggregate verdict to impressions. Use the signed impressions delta and the metric that actually drove the verdict.
MINOR: Fix Report header wrap/clipping at 390px (see design_issues).
MINOR: Align Create Launch product-name focus ring to focus:ring-ring.
MINOR (optional): replace window.confirm on audience delete with the shadcn dialog.
critical_code_review_comments: VoiceButton: when the engine IS available and listening, rec.onresult rebuilds the value from baseRef + full transcript on every result — any characters the user types while listening are silently overwritten on the next result event. Consider disabling the field or re-basing baseRef on the current value in onresult.
VoiceButton: baseRef is captured at start() from the value prop, so a stale closure value is used if the parent value changes during dictation (same root cause as above).

Layout.jsx: nav data-testids are duplicated between the desktop sidebar and the mobile drawer (both render SidebarContent). Selectors must be scoped ('aside [data-testid=...]' vs 'aside.relative [data-testid=...]'); consider suffixing the drawer testids.
Landing page has no 'demo-login-btn' testid (it is header-demo / hero-demo; demo-login-btn only exists on /login). Request description was inaccurate — worth aligning testid names.

rca_of_the_issue: Learning-note defect: the note text is generated from prediction-vs-reality deltas but uses the magnitude (not the sign) of the impressions delta and pairs it with the aggregate verdict, producing 'reality beat prediction by 94% on impressions' when impressions were actually -94.3%. Report-header clipping: the report top bar is a fixed-height flex row; at 390px the 3 action buttons + theme toggle exceed the width, wrap, and the fixed height clips/pushes the second row outside the header band.
